340struct GroupCommand // NOLINT(clang-analyzer-optin.performance.Padding)
341{
342 GroupCommandKind kind = GroupCommandKind::motion;
343 GroupPosition target{};
344 bool relative = false;
345 bool direct_semantics = false;
346 // Shared-path dynamics. Linear: the scalar path parameter is planned as
347 // one jerk-limited 1D profile referenced to the member with the longest
348 // travel (the fastest-moving member). Circular: the path parameter is the
349 // arc length in the plane of the first two axes, so velocity/limits apply
350 // to the in-plane path speed (approved circular matrix).
351 double velocity = 1.0;
352 double acceleration = 1.0;
353 double deceleration = 1.0;
354 double jerk = 1.0;
355 BufferMode buffer_mode = BufferMode::aborting;
356 std::uint32_t command_id = 0;
357
358 // Approved coordinate matrix (B1 v1): target/aux are interpreted in this
359 // frame and converted to ACS at submit time; the cycle path never sees a
360 // frame.
361 CoordSystem coord_system = CoordSystem::acs;
362
363 // Cartesian-interpolation batch: joint (default, byte-identical) or
364 // cartesian (per-cycle inverse kinematics on the precomputed
365 // line/geodesic).
366 InterpolationSpace interpolation_space = InterpolationSpace::joint;
367
368 // A4 transition inputs (linear-to-linear geometric blending v1, KB-031).
369 TransitionMode transition_mode = TransitionMode::none;
370 // Zero selects the planner-derived junction speed. A positive value is an
371 // explicit upper bound on the transition node velocity.
372 double transition_velocity = 0.0;
373 double transition_parameter = 0.0;
374 OrientationMode orientation_mode = OrientationMode::joint_space;
375
376 // Circular-only inputs (ignored by submit_linear).
377 GroupPathKind path_kind = GroupPathKind::linear;
378 CircMode circ_mode = CircMode::border;
379 CircPathChoice path_choice = CircPathChoice::counter_clockwise;
380 GroupPosition aux{};
381 // Independent circular geometry acceptance. Zero disables the additional
382 // higher-dimensional via-point residual check.
383 double tolerance = 0.0;
384 // Internal: the validated arc geometry, resolved by submit_circular from
385 // the command's deterministic start point. Not a user input.
386 geom::ArcSegment arc{};
387 CartesianSegment cart{};
388 bool use_default_dynamics = false;
389 std::size_t tool_number = 0;
390 std::size_t payload_number = 0;
391 geom::RigidTransform tool_inverse{};
392 bool dynamic_pcs = false;
393 KinTransformRef kin_transform{};
394 double min_singularity_margin = 0.0;
395 double max_joint_step = 0.01;
396 GroupParameter parameter = GroupParameter::dynamics_mode;
397 double parameter_value = 0.0;
398 GroupSWLimits sw_limits{};
399 ToolData tool_data{};
400};

423 // Members are non-owning and must remain alive while registered. Detach
424 // them on group destruction so an outliving axis never retains owner state.
425 ~AxisGroup()
426 {
427 if(path_sync_slave_ != nullptr &&
428 path_sync_slave_->sync_kind_ == SyncKind::group_path) {
429 path_sync_slave_->clear_synchronized();
430 }
431 for(std::size_t i = 0; i < axes_.size(); ++i) {
432 if(axes_[i]->group_owner() == this) {
433 axes_[i]->set_group_owner(nullptr);
434 }
435 }
436 }

453 rt::ErrorCode ungroup_all_axes()
454 {
455 if(status_ == GroupStatus::moving || status_ == GroupStatus::stopping ||
456 status_ == GroupStatus::interrupted) {
457 return rt::ErrorCode::precondition_failed;
458 }
459 abort_motion();
460 cancel_tracking();

462 axes_[i]->set_group_owner(nullptr);
463 }

465 member_idents_.clear();
466 status_ = GroupStatus::disabled;

471 rt::ErrorCode set_group_power(bool enabled)
472 {
473 if(axes_.empty()) return rt::ErrorCode::precondition_failed;
474 if(enabled) {
475 for(std::size_t i = 0; i < axes_.size(); ++i) {
476 if(axes_[i]->status() == AxisStatus::errorstop) {
477 set_group_error(rt::ErrorCode::precondition_failed);
478 return rt::ErrorCode::precondition_failed;
479 }
480 }
481 }
482 for(std::size_t i = 0; i < axes_.size(); ++i) {
483 const rt::ErrorCode result = axes_[i]->set_power(enabled);
484 if(result != rt::ErrorCode::ok) {
485 set_group_error(result);
486 return result;
487 }
488 }
489 if(!enabled && status_ != GroupStatus::disabled) {
490 abort_motion();
491 set_group_error(rt::ErrorCode::precondition_failed);
492 }
493 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
494 }

520 rt::Result<std::uint32_t> sync_axis_to_group(AxisModel &slave,
521 double ratio_numerator,
522 double ratio_denominator,
523 double acceleration,
524 double deceleration,
525 double jerk,
526 BufferMode buffer_mode)
527 {
528 if(status_ == GroupStatus::disabled || status_ == GroupStatus::errorstop ||
529 slave.group_owner() != nullptr || !slave.powered() ||
530 !std::isfinite(ratio_numerator) || !std::isfinite(ratio_denominator) ||
531 ratio_denominator == 0.0 || !std::isfinite(acceleration) ||
532 !std::isfinite(deceleration) || !std::isfinite(jerk) || acceleration < 0.0 ||
533 deceleration < 0.0 || jerk < 0.0) {
534 return rt::Result<std::uint32_t>::failure(rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument);
535 }
536 if(path_sync_slave_ != nullptr && path_sync_slave_ != &slave &&
537 path_sync_slave_->sync_kind_ == SyncKind::group_path) {
538 path_sync_slave_->clear_synchronized();
539 }
540 const rt::Result<std::uint32_t> begun =
541 slave.begin_sync(SyncKind::group_path, buffer_mode);
542 if(!begun) return begun;
543 const bool position_locked = acceleration == 0.0 && deceleration == 0.0 && jerk == 0.0;
544 slave.sync_phase_ = position_locked ? SyncPhase::engaged : SyncPhase::approaching;
545 path_sync_slave_ = &slave;
546 path_sync_id_ = begun.value();
547 path_sync_origin_ = path_odometer_;
548 path_sync_slave_origin_ = slave.snapshot().command_position;
549 path_sync_ratio_ = ratio_numerator / ratio_denominator;
550 path_sync_acceleration_ = acceleration;
551 path_sync_deceleration_ = deceleration;
552 path_sync_jerk_ = jerk;
553 path_sync_velocity_ = slave.snapshot().command_velocity;
554 path_sync_acceleration_state_ = slave.snapshot().command_acceleration;
555 path_sync_in_sync_ = position_locked;
556 return begun;
557 }
558
559 rt::Result<std::uint32_t> sync_group_to_axis(
560 AxisModel &master,
561 const GroupPosition *waypoints,
562 std::size_t count,
563 PathMode mode,
564 const std::array<int, MaxAxes> &tuc_numerator,
565 const std::array<int, MaxAxes> &tuc_denominator,
566 CoordSystem coord_system,
567 BufferMode buffer_mode)
568 {
569 if(status_ == GroupStatus::disabled || status_ == GroupStatus::errorstop ||
570 waypoints == nullptr || count < 2 || count > SyncPathCapacity ||
571 !master.powered() || master.group_owner() == this ||
572 coord_system != CoordSystem::acs || buffer_mode != BufferMode::aborting) {
573 return rt::Result<std::uint32_t>::failure(rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument);
574 }
575 for(std::size_t axis_index = 0; axis_index < axes_.size(); ++axis_index) {
576 if(tuc_numerator[axis_index] == 0 || tuc_denominator[axis_index] == 0) {
577 return rt::Result<std::uint32_t>::failure(rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument);
578 }
579 }
580 group_sync_cumulative_[0] = 0.0;
581 for(std::size_t point = 0; point < count; ++point) {
582 if(waypoints[point].size != axes_.size() || !finite(waypoints[point])) {
583 return rt::Result<std::uint32_t>::failure(rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument);
584 }
585 group_sync_waypoints_[point] = waypoints[point];
586 if(point == 0) continue;
587 double squared_length = 0.0;
588 for(std::size_t axis_index = 0; axis_index < axes_.size(); ++axis_index) {
589 const double conversion = static_cast<double>(tuc_numerator[axis_index]) /
590 static_cast<double>(tuc_denominator[axis_index]);
591 const double delta = (waypoints[point].value[axis_index] -
592 waypoints[point - 1].value[axis_index]) *
593 conversion;
594 squared_length += delta * delta;
595 }
596 const double length = std::sqrt(squared_length);
597 if(length <= 0.0 || !std::isfinite(length)) {
598 return rt::Result<std::uint32_t>::failure(rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument);
599 }
600 group_sync_cumulative_[point] = group_sync_cumulative_[point - 1] + length;
601 }
602 abort_motion();
603 group_sync_master_ = &master;
604 group_sync_master_origin_ = master.snapshot().command_position;
605 group_sync_count_ = count;
606 group_sync_mode_ = mode;
607 group_sync_id_ = next_command_id_++;
608 group_sync_active_ = true;
609 group_sync_previous_ = group_sync_waypoints_[0];
610 status_ = GroupStatus::moving;
611 return rt::Result<std::uint32_t>::success(group_sync_id_);
612 }

713 rt::ErrorCode bind_kinematics_info(const GroupKinematicsInfo &info)
714 {
715 if(status_ != GroupStatus::disabled || kinematics_info_frozen_ ||
716 !info.serial || info.count == 0 || info.count != axes_.size()) {
717 return rt::ErrorCode::precondition_failed;
718 }
719 for(std::size_t i = 0; i < info.count; ++i) {
720 const DHParameter &dh = info.dh[i];
721 if(!std::isfinite(dh.theta) || !std::isfinite(dh.d) ||
722 !std::isfinite(dh.a) || !std::isfinite(dh.alpha) ||
723 !std::isfinite(info.joint[i].zero_position)) {
724 return rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument;
725 }
726 }
727 kinematics_info_ = info;
728 kinematics_info_bound_ = true;
729 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
730 }

742 rt::Result<double> read_group_parameter(GroupParameter parameter) const
743 {
744 if(parameter == GroupParameter::dynamics_mode) {
745 return rt::Result<double>::success(static_cast<double>(dynamics_mode_));
746 }
747 if(parameter == GroupParameter::transition_reference_point) {
748 return rt::Result<double>::success(
749 static_cast<double>(transition_reference_point_));
750 }
751 return rt::Result<double>::failure(rt::ErrorCode::unsupported);
752 }
753
754 rt::ErrorCode write_group_parameter(GroupParameter parameter, double value)
755 {
756 if(!std::isfinite(value)) return rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument;
757 if(!configuration_writable()) return rt::ErrorCode::precondition_failed;
758 if(parameter == GroupParameter::dynamics_mode) {
759 if(value == static_cast<double>(DynamicsMode::absolute)) {
760 dynamics_mode_ = DynamicsMode::absolute;
761 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
762 }
763 if(value == static_cast<double>(DynamicsMode::percentage)) {
764 dynamics_mode_ = DynamicsMode::percentage;
765 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
766 }
767 return rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument;
768 }
769 if(parameter == GroupParameter::transition_reference_point) {
770 if(value == static_cast<double>(TransitionReferencePoint::end_point)) {
771 transition_reference_point_ = TransitionReferencePoint::end_point;
772 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
773 }
774 if(value == static_cast<double>(TransitionReferencePoint::start_point)) {
775 return rt::ErrorCode::unsupported;
776 }
777 return rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument;
778 }
779 return rt::ErrorCode::unsupported;
780 }

945 rt::Result<std::uint32_t> begin_jog(CoordSystem coord_system,
946 const GroupPosition &direction,
947 const JogCommandOptions &options = {})
948 {
949 const rt::ErrorCode valid = validate_jog(coord_system, direction, options);
950 if(valid != rt::ErrorCode::ok) {
951 return rt::Result<std::uint32_t>::failure(valid);
952 }
953 if(status_ != GroupStatus::standby && status_ != GroupStatus::moving &&
954 status_ != GroupStatus::stopping) {
955 return rt::Result<std::uint32_t>::failure(rt::ErrorCode::precondition_failed);
956 }
957 if(jog_active_) {
958 last_aborted_jog_id_ = jog_command_id_;
959 }
960 abort_motion();
961 jog_command_id_ = next_command_id_++;
962 jog_coord_system_ = coord_system;
963 jog_direction_ = direction;
964 jog_options_ = options;
965 jog_releasing_ = false;
966 jog_error_ = rt::ErrorCode::ok;
967 jog_stop_deceleration_ = 0.0;
968 jog_stop_jerk_ = 0.0;
969 jog_active_ = true;
970 snapshot_selections();
971 snapshot_active_tool_transform();
972 for(std::size_t i = 0; i < axes_.size(); ++i) {
973 jog_position_[i] = axes_[i]->snapshot().command_position;
974 jog_velocity_[i] = axes_[i]->snapshot().command_velocity;
975 jog_acceleration_[i] = axes_[i]->snapshot().command_acceleration;
976 }
977 if(coord_system != CoordSystem::acs) {
978 GroupPosition current{};
979 const rt::ErrorCode read =
980 read_cartesian(coord_system, PositionSource::command, current);
981 if(read != rt::ErrorCode::ok) {
982 jog_active_ = false;
983 return rt::Result<std::uint32_t>::failure(read);
984 }
985 jog_cartesian_position_ = current;
986 for(std::size_t i = 0; i < 6; ++i) {
987 jog_cartesian_start_[i] = current.value[i];
988 }
989 pose_frames_.jog_tool_offset_ = pose_frames_.tool_offset_;
990 pose_frames_.jog_pose_tool_inverse_ = pose_frames_.pose_tool_inverse_;
991 jog_cart_velocity_.fill(0.0);
992 jog_cart_acceleration_.fill(0.0);
993 }
994 status_ = any_direction(direction) ? GroupStatus::moving
995 : GroupStatus::standby;
996 return rt::Result<std::uint32_t>::success(jog_command_id_);
997 }
998
999 rt::ErrorCode update_jog(std::uint32_t command_id, const GroupPosition &direction,
1000 const JogCommandOptions &options = {})
1001 {
1002 if(!jog_active_ || command_id == 0 || command_id != jog_command_id_) {
1003 return rt::ErrorCode::precondition_failed;
1004 }
1005 if(jog_error_ != rt::ErrorCode::ok) return jog_error_;
1006 const rt::ErrorCode valid = validate_jog(jog_coord_system_, direction, options);
1007 if(valid != rt::ErrorCode::ok) return valid;
1008 jog_direction_ = direction;
1009 jog_options_ = options;
1010 jog_releasing_ = false;
1011 if(any_direction(direction)) status_ = GroupStatus::moving;
1012 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
1013 }
1014
1015 rt::ErrorCode release_jog(std::uint32_t command_id)
1016 {
1017 if(!jog_active_ || command_id == 0 || command_id != jog_command_id_) {
1018 return rt::ErrorCode::precondition_failed;
1019 }
1020 jog_direction_ = {};
1021 jog_direction_.size = jog_coord_system_ == CoordSystem::acs ? axes_.size() : 6;
1022 jog_releasing_ = true;
1023 status_ = GroupStatus::stopping;
1024 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
1025 }

1048
1049 rt::ErrorCode write_jogging_dynamics(const JoggingDynamics &update)
1050 {
1051 if(update.size != axes_.size()) return rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument;
1052 if(!configuration_writable()) return rt::ErrorCode::precondition_failed;
1053 JoggingDynamics next = jogging_dynamics_;
1054 const rt::ErrorCode path = apply_path_update(next.path, update.path);
1055 if(path != rt::ErrorCode::ok) return path;
1056 next.size = update.size;
1057 for(std::size_t i = 0; i < update.size; ++i) {
1058 const double values[4] = {update.axis_velocity[i],
1059 update.axis_acceleration[i],
1060 update.axis_deceleration[i],
1061 update.axis_jerk[i]};
1062 for(double value : values) {
1063 if(!std::isfinite(value)) return rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument;
1064 }
1065 if(update.axis_velocity[i] > 0.0) next.axis_velocity[i] = update.axis_velocity[i];
1066 if(update.axis_acceleration[i] > 0.0)
1067 next.axis_acceleration[i] = update.axis_acceleration[i];
1068 if(update.axis_deceleration[i] > 0.0)
1069 next.axis_deceleration[i] = update.axis_deceleration[i];
1070 if(update.axis_jerk[i] > 0.0) next.axis_jerk[i] = update.axis_jerk[i];
1071 }
1072 jogging_dynamics_ = next;
1073 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
1074 }

1107 rt::ErrorCode write_group_sw_limits(const GroupSWLimits &limits)
1108 {
1109 if(limits.count != axes_.size()) return rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument;
1110 if(!configuration_writable()) return rt::ErrorCode::precondition_failed;
1111 for(std::size_t i = 0; i < limits.count; ++i) {
1112 const GroupSWLimit &entry = limits.value[i];
1113 if(!std::isfinite(entry.minimum) || !std::isfinite(entry.maximum) ||
1114 entry.minimum > entry.maximum) {
1115 return rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument;
1116 }
1117 }
1118 for(std::size_t i = 0; i < limits.count; ++i) {
1119 MotionLimits next = axes_[i]->limits_;
1120 next.min_position = limits.value[i].minimum;
1121 next.max_position = limits.value[i].maximum;
1122 next.min_position_enabled = limits.value[i].minimum_enabled;
1123 next.max_position_enabled = limits.value[i].maximum_enabled;
1124 axes_[i]->limits_ = next;
1125 }
1126 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
1127 }

1134 if(valid != rt::ErrorCode::ok) return valid;

1136 axes_[i]->limits_ = next_limits[i];

1138 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;

1162 rt::ErrorCode add_axis(AxisModel &axis, IdentInGroup ident)
1163 {
1164 if(status_ != GroupStatus::disabled || axis.domain_id() != domain_id_) {
1165 return rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument;
1166 }
1167 if(axis.group_owner() == this) {
1168 return rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument;
1169 }
1170 if(axis.group_owner() != nullptr) {
1171 return rt::ErrorCode::out_of_range;
1172 }
1173 if(find(ident) < member_idents_.size()) {
1174 return rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument;
1175 }
1176
1177 const rt::ErrorCode pushed = axes_.push_back(&axis);
1178 if(pushed != rt::ErrorCode::ok) {
1179 return pushed;
1180 }
1181 const rt::ErrorCode ident_pushed = member_idents_.push_back(ident);
1182 if(ident_pushed != rt::ErrorCode::ok) {
1183 axes_.pop_back();
1184 return ident_pushed;
1185 }
1186 axis.set_group_owner(this, &status_);
1187 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
1188 }

1190 rt::ErrorCode add_axis(AxisModel &axis)
1191 {

1199 rt::ErrorCode remove_axis(IdentInGroup ident)
1200 {

1205 if(index == member_idents_.size()) {
1206 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
1207 }
1208 AxisModel *axis = axes_[index];
1209 for(std::size_t i = index + 1; i < axes_.size(); ++i) {
1210 axes_[i - 1] = axes_[i];
1211 member_idents_[i - 1] = member_idents_[i];

1213 axes_.pop_back();
1214 member_idents_.pop_back();
1215 axis->set_group_owner(nullptr);

1257 rt::ErrorCode enable()
1258 {
1259 if(status_ != GroupStatus::disabled || axes_.empty()) {
1260 return rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument;
1261 }
1262 for(std::size_t i = 0; i < axes_.size(); ++i) {
1263 if(!axes_[i]->powered()) {
1264 return rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument;
1265 }
1266 }

1271
1272 rt::ErrorCode disable()
1273 {
1274 if(direct_path_.direct_active_) {
1275 direct_path_.last_aborted_direct_id_ = direct_path_.direct_command_id_;
1276 abort_direct_members();
1277 }
1278 abort_motion();
1279 if(path_sync_slave_ != nullptr &&
1280 path_sync_slave_->sync_kind_ == SyncKind::group_path) {
1281 path_sync_slave_->clear_synchronized();
1282 }
1283 path_sync_slave_ = nullptr;
1284 path_sync_id_ = 0;
1285 cancel_tracking();
1286 status_ = GroupStatus::disabled;
1287 for(std::size_t i = 0; i < axes_.size(); ++i) {
1288 axes_[i]->clear_synchronized();
1289 }
1290 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
1291 }
1292
1293 // MC_GroupStop: controlled deceleration along the original path. The halt
1294 // profile re-plans the path parameter from its current sampled state to
1295 // the minimal braking point (KB-027); a live circular takeover also
1296 // re-plans its member residuals instead of dropping the tolerance tube.
1297 rt::ErrorCode stop(double deceleration = 1.0, double jerk = 1.0)
1298 {
1299 if(cartesian_.window_active_ && !cartesian_.window_stopping_) {
1300 return cart_window_stop(deceleration, jerk);
1301 }
1302 if(status_ == GroupStatus::disabled || status_ == GroupStatus::errorstop ||
1303 !std::isfinite(deceleration) || deceleration <= 0.0 || !std::isfinite(jerk) ||
1304 jerk <= 0.0) {
1305 return rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument;
1306 }
1307 if(group_sync_active_) {
1308 abort_motion();
1309 status_ = GroupStatus::standby;
1310 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
1311 }
1312 if(status_ != GroupStatus::moving) {
1313 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
1314 }
1315 if(jog_active_) {
1316 jog_stop_deceleration_ = deceleration;
1317 jog_stop_jerk_ = jerk;
1318 last_aborted_jog_id_ = jog_command_id_;
1319 return release_jog(jog_command_id_);
1320 }
1321 if(direct_path_.direct_active_) {
1322 return stop_direct_members(deceleration, jerk);
1323 }
1324 queue_.clear();
1325 if(joint_window_.active_) {
1326 // Controlled stop along the committed window geometry (KB-032):
1327 // one halt profile over the composite arc length; not-yet-started
1328 // commands are cleared (they never execute), the geometry is kept
1329 // for braking. Mirrors the KB-027 clamp trick: the halt target may
1330 // lie past the path end, sampling clamps at the terminal point.
1331 if(joint_window_.stopping_) {
1332 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
1333 }
1334 double s_live = 0.0;
1335 double v_live = 0.0;
1336 double a_live = 0.0;
1337 window_live_state(s_live, v_live, a_live);
1338 if(v_live <= 0.0) {
1339 window_reset();
1340 clear_axes_synchronized();
1341 status_ = GroupStatus::standby;
1342 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
1343 }
1344 const WindowSegment &seg = joint_window_.segments_[joint_window_.index_];
1345 const otg::Limits1D halt_limits{seg.limits.max_velocity,
1346 seg.limits.max_acceleration, deceleration, jerk};
1347 double brake_velocity = v_live;
1348 double brake_shift = 0.0;
1349 if(a_live != 0.0) {
1350 const double zero_cycles = std::ceil(std::fabs(a_live) / jerk);
1351 brake_velocity += 0.5 * a_live * zero_cycles;
1352 brake_shift += v_live * zero_cycles + a_live * zero_cycles * zero_cycles / 3.0;
1353 }
1354 if(brake_velocity < 0.0) {
1355 brake_velocity = 0.0;
1356 }
1357 const double stop_position =
1358 brake_shift +
1359 otg::detail::ramp_between(brake_velocity, 0.0, halt_limits).distance;
1360 const rt::Result<otg::Profile1D> halt = otg::plan_time_optimal(
1361 {0.0, v_live, a_live}, {stop_position, 0.0, 0.0}, halt_limits);
1362 if(!halt) {
1363 window_reset();
1364 clear_axes_synchronized();
1365 status_ = GroupStatus::standby;
1366 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
1367 }
1368 joint_window_.stopping_ = true;
1369 joint_window_.stop_profile_ = halt.value();
1370 joint_window_.stop_origin_ = s_live;
1371 joint_window_.tick_ = 0;
1372 status_ = GroupStatus::stopping;
1373 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
1374 }
1375 if(!active_ || active_path_length_ <= 0.0) {
1376 abort_motion();
1377 status_ = GroupStatus::standby;
1378 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
1379 }
1380
1381 const otg::State1D state =
1382 otg::sample(active_profile_, rt::CycleTick::from_cycles(active_tick_));
1383 if(connector_.vector_mode()) {
1384 const otg::Limits1D stop_limits{
1385 active_command_.velocity, active_command_.acceleration,
1386 deceleration, jerk};
1387 std::array<double, MaxAxes> output_velocity{};
1388 std::array<double, MaxAxes> output_acceleration{};
1389 current_member_output_state(output_velocity, output_acceleration);
1390 otg::Profile1D halt_profile{};
1391 std::int64_t halt_duration = 0;
1392 const rt::ErrorCode planned =
1393 active_kind_ == GroupPathKind::circular
1394 ? connector_.plan_circular_stop(
1395 stop_limits, active_path_length_, axes_.size(),
1396 active_start_, active_finish_, active_arc_,
1397 active_profile_, active_tick_, output_velocity,
1398 output_acceleration, halt_profile, halt_duration)
1399 : connector_.plan_linear_vector_stop(
1400 stop_limits, active_path_length_, axes_.size(),
1401 active_start_, active_finish_, active_profile_,
1402 active_tick_, output_velocity, output_acceleration,
1403 halt_profile, halt_duration);
1404 if(planned == rt::ErrorCode::ok) {
1405 active_profile_ = halt_profile;
1406 active_tick_ = 0;
1407 active_duration_ = halt_duration;
1408 status_ = GroupStatus::stopping;
1409 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
1410 }
1411 // A finite path, continuity and the requested stop envelope cannot
1412 // all be preserved when the remaining segment is too short. Freeze at
1413 // the last commanded point and report the planning error instead
1414 // of snapping the residual back to the base arc.
1415 abort_motion();
1416 status_ = GroupStatus::standby;
1417 return planned;
1418 }
1419 if(state.velocity <= 0.0) {
1420 abort_motion();
1421 status_ = GroupStatus::standby;
1422 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
1423 }
1424
1425 // Minimal braking distance: fold the acceleration-zeroing ramp, then
1426 // the jerk-limited ramp to rest (same primitives as the planner). The
1427 // acceleration bound stays the original command's so the current
1428 // profile state is always inside the halt envelope.
1429 const otg::Limits1D halt_limits{active_command_.velocity,
1430 active_command_.acceleration, deceleration, jerk};
1431 double brake_velocity = state.velocity;
1432 double brake_shift = 0.0;
1433 if(state.acceleration != 0.0) {
1434 const double zero_cycles = std::ceil(std::fabs(state.acceleration) / jerk);
1435 brake_velocity += 0.5 * state.acceleration * zero_cycles;
1436 brake_shift += state.velocity * zero_cycles +
1437 state.acceleration * zero_cycles * zero_cycles / 3.0;
1438 }
1439 if(brake_velocity < 0.0) {
1440 brake_velocity = 0.0;
1441 }
1442 const double stop_position = state.position + brake_shift +
1443 otg::detail::ramp_between(brake_velocity, 0.0, halt_limits)
1444 .distance;
1445
1446 const rt::Result<otg::Profile1D> halt = otg::plan_time_optimal(
1447 state, {stop_position, 0.0, 0.0}, halt_limits);
1448 if(!halt) {
1449 // Fall back to the immediate stop rather than continuing motion.
1450 abort_motion();
1451 status_ = GroupStatus::standby;
1452 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
1453 }
1454 active_profile_ = halt.value();
1455 active_tick_ = 0;
1456 active_duration_ = active_profile_.duration_cycles();
1457 connector_.deactivate();
1458 status_ = GroupStatus::stopping;
1459 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
1460 }
1461
1462 rt::Result<std::uint32_t> halt(double deceleration = 1.0,
1463 double jerk = 1.0,
1464 BufferMode buffer_mode = BufferMode::aborting)
1465 {
1466 if(buffer_mode != BufferMode::aborting && buffer_mode != BufferMode::buffered) {
1467 return rt::Result<std::uint32_t>::failure(rt::ErrorCode::unsupported);
1468 }
1469 if(!std::isfinite(deceleration) || deceleration <= 0.0 ||
1470 !std::isfinite(jerk) || jerk <= 0.0 ||
1471 status_ == GroupStatus::disabled || status_ == GroupStatus::errorstop) {
1472 return rt::Result<std::uint32_t>::failure(rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument);
1473 }
1474 if(buffer_mode == BufferMode::buffered) {
1475 GroupCommand command{};
1476 command.kind = GroupCommandKind::halt;
1477 command.deceleration = deceleration;
1478 command.jerk = jerk;
1479 command.buffer_mode = buffer_mode;
1480 command.command_id = next_command_id_++;
1481 const rt::ErrorCode queued = queue_.push_back(command);
1482 if(queued != rt::ErrorCode::ok) {
1483 return rt::Result<std::uint32_t>::failure(queued);
1484 }
1485 halt_command_id_ = command.command_id;
1486 halt_command_live_ = true;
1487 return rt::Result<std::uint32_t>::success(command.command_id);
1488 }
1489 abort_wait();
1490 abort_queued_management();
1491 if(halt_command_live_) {
1492 if(halt_command_done(halt_command_id_)) {
1493 last_completed_halt_id_ = halt_command_id_;
1494 } else {
1495 last_aborted_halt_id_ = halt_command_id_;
1496 }
1497 }
1498 const rt::ErrorCode result = stop(deceleration, jerk);
1499 if(result != rt::ErrorCode::ok) {
1500 return rt::Result<std::uint32_t>::failure(result);
1501 }
1502 halt_command_id_ = next_command_id_++;
1503 halt_command_live_ = true;
1504 return rt::Result<std::uint32_t>::success(halt_command_id_);
1505 }
1506
1507 bool halt_command_done(std::uint32_t command_id) const
1508 {
1509 return command_id != 0 &&
1510 (command_id == last_completed_halt_id_ ||
1511 (halt_command_live_ && command_id == halt_command_id_ &&
1512 status_ == GroupStatus::standby));
1513 }
1514
1515 bool halt_command_active(std::uint32_t command_id) const
1516 {
1517 return halt_command_live_ && command_id == halt_command_id_ &&
1518 status_ != GroupStatus::standby && !command_queued(command_id);
1519 }
1520
1521 bool halt_command_aborted(std::uint32_t command_id) const
1522 {
1523 return command_id != 0 && command_id == last_aborted_halt_id_;
1524 }
1525
1526 rt::ErrorCode set_task_cycle_period_ns(std::int64_t period_ns)
1527 {
1528 if(period_ns <= 0) return rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument;
1529 if(!configuration_writable()) return rt::ErrorCode::precondition_failed;
1530 task_cycle_period_ns_ = period_ns;
1531 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
1532 }
1533
1534 std::int64_t task_cycle_period_ns() const { return task_cycle_period_ns_; }
1535
1536 rt::Result<std::uint32_t> submit_wait(std::int64_t duration_ns,
1537 BufferMode buffer_mode)
1538 {
1539 if(duration_ns <= 0 || status_ == GroupStatus::disabled ||
1540 status_ == GroupStatus::errorstop) {
1541 return rt::Result<std::uint32_t>::failure(rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument);
1542 }
1543 if(buffer_mode != BufferMode::aborting && buffer_mode != BufferMode::buffered) {
1544 return rt::Result<std::uint32_t>::failure(rt::ErrorCode::unsupported);
1545 }
1546 if(wait_state_ == GroupWaitState::queued || wait_state_ == GroupWaitState::stopping ||
1547 wait_state_ == GroupWaitState::active) {
1548 return rt::Result<std::uint32_t>::failure(rt::ErrorCode::precondition_failed);
1549 }
1550 if(buffer_mode == BufferMode::buffered && !queue_.empty()) {
1551 return rt::Result<std::uint32_t>::failure(rt::ErrorCode::unsupported);
1552 }
1553
1554 wait_command_id_ = next_command_id_++;
1555 wait_duration_cycles_ = duration_ns / task_cycle_period_ns_;
1556 if(duration_ns % task_cycle_period_ns_ != 0) ++wait_duration_cycles_;
1557 wait_elapsed_cycles_ = 0;
1558 if(buffer_mode == BufferMode::aborting) {
1559 const rt::ErrorCode stopped = stop();
1560 if(stopped != rt::ErrorCode::ok) {
1561 wait_command_id_ = 0;
1562 return rt::Result<std::uint32_t>::failure(stopped);
1563 }
1564 wait_state_ = status_ == GroupStatus::stopping ? GroupWaitState::stopping
1565 : GroupWaitState::active;
1566 } else {
1567 wait_state_ = status_ == GroupStatus::standby ? GroupWaitState::active
1568 : GroupWaitState::queued;
1569 }
1570 return rt::Result<std::uint32_t>::success(wait_command_id_);
1571 }
1572
1573 bool wait_command_done(std::uint32_t command_id) const
1574 {
1575 return command_id != 0 && command_id == wait_command_id_ &&
1576 wait_state_ == GroupWaitState::completed;
1577 }
1578
1579 bool wait_command_active(std::uint32_t command_id) const
1580 {
1581 return command_id != 0 && command_id == wait_command_id_ &&
1582 wait_state_ == GroupWaitState::active;
1583 }
1584
1585 bool wait_command_busy(std::uint32_t command_id) const
1586 {
1587 return command_id != 0 && command_id == wait_command_id_ &&
1588 (wait_state_ == GroupWaitState::queued ||
1589 wait_state_ == GroupWaitState::stopping ||
1590 wait_state_ == GroupWaitState::active);
1591 }
1592
1593 bool wait_command_aborted(std::uint32_t command_id) const
1594 {
1595 return command_id != 0 && command_id == last_aborted_wait_id_;
1596 }
1597
1598 // MC_GroupInterrupt: controlled deceleration preserving active/queue/window
1599 // state and the pause point. Transitions moving→stopping→interrupted.
1600 rt::ErrorCode interrupt(double deceleration = 1.0, double jerk = 1.0)
1601 {
1602 if(status_ != GroupStatus::moving || !std::isfinite(deceleration) ||
1603 deceleration <= 0.0 || !std::isfinite(jerk) || jerk <= 0.0) {
1604 return rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument;
1605 }
1606 if(direct_path_.direct_active_) {
1607 return rt::ErrorCode::unsupported;
1608 }
1609 if(cartesian_.window_active_ || cartesian_.window_stopping_) {
1610 return rt::ErrorCode::unsupported;
1611 }
1612 if(connector_.active()) {
1613 return rt::ErrorCode::unsupported;
1614 }
1615 if(joint_window_.active_) {
1616 if(joint_window_.stopping_) {
1617 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
1618 }
1619 double s_live = 0.0;
1620 double v_live = 0.0;
1621 double a_live = 0.0;
1622 window_live_state(s_live, v_live, a_live);
1623 if(v_live <= 0.0) {
1624 interrupted_window_ = true;
1625 interrupted_plain_ = false;
1626 status_ = GroupStatus::interrupted;
1627 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
1628 }
1629 const WindowSegment &seg = joint_window_.segments_[joint_window_.index_];
1630 const otg::Limits1D halt_limits{seg.limits.max_velocity,
1631 seg.limits.max_acceleration, deceleration, jerk};
1632 double brake_velocity = v_live;
1633 double brake_shift = 0.0;
1634 if(a_live != 0.0) {
1635 const double zero_cycles = std::ceil(std::fabs(a_live) / jerk);
1636 brake_velocity += 0.5 * a_live * zero_cycles;
1637 brake_shift += v_live * zero_cycles + a_live * zero_cycles * zero_cycles / 3.0;
1638 }
1639 if(brake_velocity < 0.0) {
1640 brake_velocity = 0.0;
1641 }
1642 const double stop_position =
1643 brake_shift +
1644 otg::detail::ramp_between(brake_velocity, 0.0, halt_limits).distance;
1645 const rt::Result<otg::Profile1D> halt = otg::plan_time_optimal(
1646 {0.0, v_live, a_live}, {stop_position, 0.0, 0.0}, halt_limits);
1647 if(!halt) {
1648 interrupted_window_ = true;
1649 interrupted_plain_ = false;
1650 status_ = GroupStatus::interrupted;
1651 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
1652 }
1653 joint_window_.stopping_ = true;
1654 joint_window_.stop_profile_ = halt.value();
1655 joint_window_.stop_origin_ = s_live;
1656 joint_window_.tick_ = 0;
1657 interrupting_ = true;
1658 interrupted_window_ = true;
1659 interrupted_plain_ = false;
1660 status_ = GroupStatus::stopping;
1661 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
1662 }
1663 if(!active_ || active_path_length_ <= 0.0) {
1664 interrupted_plain_ = false;
1665 interrupted_window_ = false;
1666 status_ = GroupStatus::interrupted;
1667 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
1668 }
1669 const otg::State1D state =
1670 otg::sample(active_profile_, rt::CycleTick::from_cycles(active_tick_));
1671 if(state.velocity <= 0.0) {
1672 interrupted_plain_ = true;
1673 interrupted_window_ = false;
1674 interrupt_ratio_ = state.position / active_path_length_;
1675 if(interrupt_ratio_ > 1.0) { interrupt_ratio_ = 1.0; }
1676 active_ = false;
1677 status_ = GroupStatus::interrupted;
1678 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
1679 }
1680 const otg::Limits1D halt_limits{active_command_.velocity,
1681 active_command_.acceleration, deceleration, jerk};
1682 double brake_velocity = state.velocity;
1683 double brake_shift = 0.0;
1684 if(state.acceleration != 0.0) {
1685 const double zero_cycles = std::ceil(std::fabs(state.acceleration) / jerk);
1686 brake_velocity += 0.5 * state.acceleration * zero_cycles;
1687 brake_shift += state.velocity * zero_cycles +
1688 state.acceleration * zero_cycles * zero_cycles / 3.0;
1689 }
1690 if(brake_velocity < 0.0) {
1691 brake_velocity = 0.0;
1692 }
1693 const double stop_position = state.position + brake_shift +
1694 otg::detail::ramp_between(brake_velocity, 0.0, halt_limits)
1695 .distance;
1696 const rt::Result<otg::Profile1D> halt = otg::plan_time_optimal(
1697 state, {stop_position, 0.0, 0.0}, halt_limits);
1698 if(!halt) {
1699 interrupted_plain_ = true;
1700 interrupted_window_ = false;
1701 interrupt_ratio_ = state.position / active_path_length_;
1702 if(interrupt_ratio_ > 1.0) { interrupt_ratio_ = 1.0; }
1703 active_ = false;
1704 status_ = GroupStatus::interrupted;
1705 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
1706 }
1707 active_profile_ = halt.value();
1708 active_tick_ = 0;
1709 active_duration_ = active_profile_.duration_cycles();
1710 connector_.deactivate();
1711 interrupting_ = true;
1712 interrupted_plain_ = true;
1713 interrupted_window_ = false;
1714 status_ = GroupStatus::stopping;
1715 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
1716 }
1717
1718 // MC_GroupContinue: resume from interrupted state, replanning remaining
1719 // path geometry from rest at the pause position.
1720 rt::ErrorCode continue_motion()
1721 {
1722 if(status_ != GroupStatus::interrupted) {
1723 return rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument;
1724 }
1725 if(interrupted_plain_) {
1726 for(std::size_t i = 0; i < axes_.size(); ++i) {
1727 active_start_[i] = axes_[i]->snapshot().command_position;
1728 }
1729 const double remaining = active_path_length_ * (1.0 - interrupt_ratio_);
1730 if(remaining <= 0.0) {
1731 interrupted_plain_ = false;
1732 interrupted_window_ = false;
1733 status_ = GroupStatus::standby;
1734 clear_axes_synchronized();
1735 start_next_queued();
1736 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
1737 }
1738 active_path_length_ = remaining;
1739 const otg::Limits1D limits{
1740 active_command_.velocity * group_override_,
1741 active_command_.acceleration * group_acc_override_,
1742 active_command_.deceleration * group_acc_override_,
1743 active_command_.jerk * group_jerk_override_};
1744 const rt::Result<otg::Profile1D> profile = otg::plan_time_optimal(
1745 {0.0, 0.0, 0.0}, {remaining, 0.0, 0.0}, limits);
1746 if(!profile) {
1747 return profile.error();
1748 }
1749 active_profile_ = profile.value();
1750 active_tick_ = 0;
1751 active_duration_ = active_profile_.duration_cycles();
1752 active_ = true;
1753 interrupted_plain_ = false;
1754 interrupted_window_ = false;
1755 interrupting_ = false;
1756 status_ = GroupStatus::moving;
1757 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
1758 }
1759 if(interrupted_window_) {
1760 if(!joint_window_.active_ || joint_window_.segments_.empty()) {
1761 interrupted_window_ = false;
1762 interrupted_plain_ = false;
1763 status_ = GroupStatus::standby;
1764 clear_axes_synchronized();
1765 start_next_queued();
1766 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
1767 }
1768 joint_window_.stopping_ = false;
1769 joint_window_.in_curve_ = false;
1770 joint_window_.tick_ = 0;
1771 for(std::size_t i = 0; i < axes_.size(); ++i) {
1772 joint_window_.segments_[joint_window_.index_].entry[i] = axes_[i]->snapshot().command_position;
1773 }
1774 for(std::size_t s = joint_window_.index_; s < joint_window_.segments_.size(); ++s) {
1775 joint_window_.segments_[s].limits.max_velocity *= group_override_;
1776 joint_window_.segments_[s].limits.max_acceleration *= group_acc_override_;
1777 joint_window_.segments_[s].limits.max_deceleration *= group_acc_override_;
1778 joint_window_.segments_[s].limits.max_jerk *= group_jerk_override_;
1779 }
1780 bool late = false;
1781 if(!window_rebuild(late)) {
1782 window_reset();
1783 clear_axes_synchronized();
1784 interrupted_window_ = false;
1785 interrupted_plain_ = false;
1786 status_ = GroupStatus::standby;
1787 start_next_queued();
1788 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
1789 }
1790 interrupted_window_ = false;
1791 interrupted_plain_ = false;
1792 interrupting_ = false;
1793 status_ = GroupStatus::moving;
1794 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
1795 }
1796 interrupted_plain_ = false;
1797 interrupted_window_ = false;
1798 status_ = GroupStatus::standby;
1799 clear_axes_synchronized();
1800 start_next_queued();
1801 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
1802 }
1803
1804 // MC_GroupSetOverride: independent group velocity, acceleration and jerk
1805 // factors. A zero velocity factor performs the existing controlled freeze.
1806 rt::ErrorCode set_group_override(double factor, double acc_factor = 1.0,
1807 double jerk_factor = 1.0)
1808 {
1809 if(!std::isfinite(factor) || factor < 0.0 || factor > 1.0 ||
1810 !std::isfinite(acc_factor) || acc_factor < 0.0 ||
1811 acc_factor > 1.0 || !std::isfinite(jerk_factor) ||
1812 jerk_factor < 0.0 || jerk_factor > 1.0) {
1813 return rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument;
1814 }
1815 if(status_ == GroupStatus::disabled || status_ == GroupStatus::errorstop) {
1816 return rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument;
1817 }
1818 if(direct_path_.direct_active_) {
1819 return rt::ErrorCode::unsupported;
1820 }
1821 if(connector_.active()) {
1822 return rt::ErrorCode::unsupported;
1823 }
1824 const double previous = group_override_;
1825 const double previous_acc = group_acc_override_;
1826 const double previous_jerk = group_jerk_override_;
1827 group_override_ = factor;
1828 group_acc_override_ = acc_factor;
1829 group_jerk_override_ = jerk_factor;
1830 if(previous == factor && previous_acc == acc_factor &&
1831 previous_jerk == jerk_factor) {
1832 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
1833 }
1834 if(status_ != GroupStatus::moving) {
1835 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
1836 }
1837 if(cartesian_.window_active_) {
1838 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
1839 }
1840 if(joint_window_.active_ && !joint_window_.stopping_) {
1841 if(factor == 0.0) {
1842 const rt::ErrorCode paused = interrupt(active_command_.deceleration,
1843 active_command_.jerk);
1844 if(paused != rt::ErrorCode::ok) {
1845 group_override_ = previous;
1846 group_acc_override_ = previous_acc;
1847 group_jerk_override_ = previous_jerk;
1848 return paused;
1849 }
1850 joint_window_.override_paused_ = true;
1851 status_ = GroupStatus::moving;
1852 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
1853 }
1854 if(joint_window_.override_paused_) {
1855 joint_window_.override_paused_ = false;
1856 status_ = GroupStatus::interrupted;
1857 group_override_ = 1.0;
1858 const rt::ErrorCode resumed = continue_motion();
1859 if(resumed != rt::ErrorCode::ok || status_ != GroupStatus::moving) {
1860 group_override_ = factor;
1861 group_acc_override_ = acc_factor;
1862 group_jerk_override_ = jerk_factor;
1863 return resumed;
1864 }
1865 return set_group_override(factor, acc_factor, jerk_factor);
1866 }
1867 for(std::size_t s = joint_window_.index_ + 1; s < joint_window_.segments_.size(); ++s) {
1868 if(previous > 0.0) {
1869 joint_window_.segments_[s].limits.max_velocity =
1870 joint_window_.segments_[s].limits.max_velocity * (factor / previous);
1871 } else {
1872 double v = active_command_.velocity * factor;
1873 if(joint_window_.segments_[s].kind == WindowKind::arc) {
1874 const double junction = std::fmin(
1875 joint_window_.segments_[s].limits.max_acceleration,
1876 joint_window_.segments_[s].limits.max_deceleration);
1877 const double centripetal =
1878 std::sqrt(junction * joint_window_.segments_[s].arc_geom.radius);
1879 if(centripetal < v) {
1880 v = centripetal;
1881 }
1882 }
1883 joint_window_.segments_[s].limits.max_velocity = v;
1884 }
1885 joint_window_.segments_[s].limits.max_acceleration =
1886 previous_acc > 0.0
1887 ? joint_window_.segments_[s].limits.max_acceleration *
1888 (acc_factor / previous_acc)
1889 : active_command_.acceleration * acc_factor;
1890 joint_window_.segments_[s].limits.max_deceleration =
1891 previous_acc > 0.0
1892 ? joint_window_.segments_[s].limits.max_deceleration *
1893 (acc_factor / previous_acc)
1894 : active_command_.deceleration * acc_factor;
1895 joint_window_.segments_[s].limits.max_jerk =
1896 previous_jerk > 0.0
1897 ? joint_window_.segments_[s].limits.max_jerk *
1898 (jerk_factor / previous_jerk)
1899 : active_command_.jerk * jerk_factor;
1900 }
1901 if(joint_window_.index_ + 1 < joint_window_.segments_.size()) {
1902 bool late = false;
1903 window_rebuild(late);
1904 }
1905 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
1906 }
1907 if(!active_ || active_path_length_ <= 0.0) {
1908 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
1909 }
1910 const otg::State1D state =
1911 otg::sample(active_profile_, rt::CycleTick::from_cycles(active_tick_));
1912 const double remaining = active_path_length_ - state.position;
1913 if(remaining <= 0.0) {
1914 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
1915 }
1916 if(factor == 0.0) {
1917 const double deceleration = active_command_.deceleration;
1918 const double jerk = active_command_.jerk;
1919 const otg::Limits1D halt_limits{active_command_.velocity,
1920 active_command_.acceleration,
1921 deceleration, jerk};
1922 double brake_velocity = state.velocity;
1923 double brake_shift = 0.0;
1924 if(state.acceleration != 0.0) {
1925 const double zero_cycles =
1926 std::ceil(std::fabs(state.acceleration) / jerk);
1927 brake_velocity += 0.5 * state.acceleration * zero_cycles;
1928 brake_shift += state.velocity * zero_cycles +
1929 state.acceleration * zero_cycles * zero_cycles / 3.0;
1930 }
1931 if(brake_velocity < 0.0) { brake_velocity = 0.0; }
1932 const double stop_position = state.position + brake_shift +
1933 otg::detail::ramp_between(brake_velocity, 0.0, halt_limits).distance;
1934 const rt::Result<otg::Profile1D> profile = otg::plan_time_optimal(
1935 state, {stop_position, 0.0, 0.0}, halt_limits);
1936 if(!profile) {
1937 group_override_ = previous;
1938 group_acc_override_ = previous_acc;
1939 group_jerk_override_ = previous_jerk;
1940 return profile.error();
1941 }
1942 active_profile_ = profile.value();
1943 active_tick_ = 0;
1944 active_duration_ = active_profile_.duration_cycles();
1945 override_paused_ = true;
1946 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
1947 }
1948 if(override_paused_) {
1949 override_paused_ = false;
1950 }
1951 const otg::Limits1D limits{
1952 active_command_.velocity * factor,
1953 active_command_.acceleration * acc_factor,
1954 active_command_.deceleration * acc_factor,
1955 active_command_.jerk * jerk_factor};
1956 const rt::Result<otg::Profile1D> profile = otg::plan_time_optimal(
1957 state, {active_path_length_, 0.0, 0.0}, limits);
1958 if(!profile) {
1959 group_override_ = previous;
1960 group_acc_override_ = previous_acc;
1961 group_jerk_override_ = previous_jerk;
1962 return profile.error();
1963 }
1964 active_profile_ = profile.value();
1965 active_tick_ = 0;
1966 active_duration_ = active_profile_.duration_cycles();
1967 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
1968 }
1969
1970 double group_override() const
1971 {
1972 return group_override_;
1973 }
1974

1984 // Legacy direct entry retained for internal callers; the public FB uses
1985 // submit_group_home so Position/CoordSystem/BufferMode enter the group
1986 // command queue and have an observable lifecycle.
1987 rt::ErrorCode group_home()
1988 {
1989 if(status_ != GroupStatus::standby || !queue_.empty()) {
1990 return rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument;
1991 }
1992 if(!members_ready_for_group_motion()) {
1993 return rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument;
1994 }
1995 for(std::size_t i = 0; i < axes_.size(); ++i) {
1996 const rt::ErrorCode homed = axes_[i]->home_direct(0.0);
1997 if(homed != rt::ErrorCode::ok) {
1998 abort_motion();
1999 set_group_error(homed);
2000 return homed;
2001 }
2002 }
2003 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
2004 }
2005
2006 rt::Result<std::uint32_t> submit_group_home(const GroupPosition &position,
2007 CoordSystem coordinate_system,
2008 BufferMode buffer_mode)
2009 {
2010 if(buffer_mode != BufferMode::aborting && buffer_mode != BufferMode::buffered) {
2011 return rt::Result<std::uint32_t>::failure(rt::ErrorCode::unsupported);
2012 }
2013 if(status_ == GroupStatus::disabled || status_ == GroupStatus::errorstop ||
2014 status_ == GroupStatus::interrupted || axes_.empty()) {
2015 return rt::Result<std::uint32_t>::failure(rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument);
2016 }
2017 GroupPosition requested = position;
2018 if(requested.size == 0) requested.size = axes_.size();
2019 GroupPosition resolved{};
2020 bool singular = false;
2021 const rt::ErrorCode transformed = transform_position(
2022 requested, coordinate_system, CoordSystem::acs, resolved, singular);
2023 if(transformed != rt::ErrorCode::ok) {
2024 return rt::Result<std::uint32_t>::failure(transformed);
2025 }
2026 if(singular) {
2027 return rt::Result<std::uint32_t>::failure(rt::ErrorCode::precondition_failed);
2028 }
2029 const rt::ErrorCode limited = preflight_member_targets(resolved);
2030 if(limited != rt::ErrorCode::ok) {
2031 return rt::Result<std::uint32_t>::failure(limited);
2032 }
2033
2034 GroupCommand command{};
2035 command.kind = GroupCommandKind::home;
2036 command.target = resolved;
2037 command.buffer_mode = buffer_mode;
2038 command.command_id = next_command_id_++;
2039 if(buffer_mode == BufferMode::aborting) {
2040 abort_wait();
2041 abort_halt();
2042 abort_motion();
2043 status_ = GroupStatus::standby;
2044 }
2045 const rt::ErrorCode queued = queue_.push_back(command);
2046 if(queued != rt::ErrorCode::ok) {
2047 return rt::Result<std::uint32_t>::failure(queued);
2048 }
2049 return rt::Result<std::uint32_t>::success(command.command_id);
2050 }

2052 bool group_homing() const
2053 {
2054 if(active_management_kind_ == GroupCommandKind::home) return true;
2055 for(std::size_t i = 0; i < queue_.size(); ++i) {
2056 if(queue_[i].kind == GroupCommandKind::home) return true;
2057 }
2058 return false;
2059 }

2233 rt::ErrorCode set_group_position(const GroupPosition &position,
2234 bool relative,
2235 CoordSystem coordinate_system,
2236 ExecutionMode execution_mode)
2237 {
2238 if(execution_mode != ExecutionMode::immediately ||
2239 status_ != GroupStatus::standby || !configuration_writable()) {
2240 return rt::ErrorCode::unsupported;
2241 }
2242 GroupPosition resolved{};
2243 bool singular = false;
2244 const rt::ErrorCode transformed = transform_position(
2245 position, coordinate_system, CoordSystem::acs, resolved, singular);
2246 if(transformed != rt::ErrorCode::ok) return transformed;
2247 if(singular) return rt::ErrorCode::precondition_failed;
2248 if(relative) {
2249 for(std::size_t i = 0; i < resolved.size; ++i) {
2250 resolved.value[i] += axes_[i]->snapshot().command_position;
2251 }
2252 }
2253 const rt::ErrorCode preflight = preflight_member_targets(resolved);
2254 if(preflight != rt::ErrorCode::ok) return preflight;
2255 for(std::size_t i = 0; i < resolved.size; ++i) {
2256 const rt::ErrorCode result = axes_[i]->set_position(resolved.value[i]);
2257 if(result != rt::ErrorCode::ok) return result;
2258 }
2259 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
2260 }
